title: THE THREATS OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE SCALE (ΤΑΙ). DEVELOPMENT, MEASUREMENT AND TEST OVER THREE APPLICATION DOMAINS.
reasoning: The paper develops a psychometric scale to measure the public's perception of threats from AI. While these perceptions may be rooted in ethical concerns, the paper itself does not evaluate or benchmark ethical principles, moral frameworks, or religious beliefs. It is a social science study measuring public attitudes, not a work of applied ethics.
